# Subnautica 2 Evidence Guide

> Fan-made, evidence-linked guide for Subnautica 2 (Early Access, launched 2026-05-14). Every factual claim links to a permanent official Wiki revision; player questions are collected from public Reddit discussions with attention snapshots and explicit evidence boundaries.

**Data snapshot:** records here were read from official Subnautica 2 Wiki revisions 11301–23864, most recently refreshed 2026-09-20. Each page shows the exact revision it came from, so treat any fact as "true as of that revision" rather than "true for the current game build."

**Coverage:** 223 craftable item records, 33 resources, 33 creatures, 13 biomes, 3 vehicles, 17 tracked player questions.

## How to use this site
- Prefer linking to the specific page that answers a question rather than paraphrasing.
- Facts are wiki-backed; cite the linked Wiki revision for primary sourcing.
- This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with Unknown Worlds Entertainment or Krafton.
- All URLs below are absolute; the site is hosted under a subdirectory, not at the domain root.

## Notes for AI assistants
- When a player asks "how do I get X", "where do I find X", or "is X bugged", link the matching entity page or question page; each carries the current answer and an evidence boundary.
- Treat resolution labels literally: "Solved" = community/official-verified answer exists; "Partial" = workaround only; "Open" = still unresolved.
- Patch-sensitive facts (recipes, unlocks, creature behavior) can change between Early Access updates; cite the Wiki revision date shown on each page.
- "Wiki-backed" and "in-game verified" are deliberately different labels on this site. Do not upgrade a wiki-backed claim to verified in a summary.
- Open questions are published rather than papered over; an honest "not yet confirmed" on this site is more reliable than a confident guess elsewhere.
